Field 1: link rectangle left, whole tiles (StrToFloat).
Field 2: link rectangle top, whole tiles.
Field 3: link rectangle width, whole tiles.
Field 4: link rectangle height, whole tiles.
Field 5 if present, else empty. The literal "-1" is rewritten to "playerx".
Field 6 if present, else empty. The literal "-1" is rewritten to "playery".
